title: Cover isolated target row rejection in the direct-prompt fixture save
outcome: Exercise the fixture outcome save when a synchronous SQLite write succeeds overall while rejecting the exact target session row.
acceptance: The behavioral control isolates the target row rejection in a synchronous save and would fail if require_session_saved(target) were removed.

The exact bounded unconfirmed-save Conflict is returned, the committed row stays HandingOff, the live Ambiguous receipt retains its original association and attempt identity, and no runtime command is sent.
